description: This file defines a SwiftUI UIViewRepresentable component called ScreenWebView, which embeds a WKWebView into a SwiftUI view hierarchy. It includes a coordinator class for managing the web view, its navigation delegate, and message handlers for communication between JavaScript and Swift. The file handles setting up the web view, intercepting deep links with a custom URL scheme, and managing lifecycle events.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: Manages the WKWebView instance, navigation delegate, message handlers, and lifecycle, coordinating between SwiftUI and WebKit.

classes.name: ScreenNavigationDelegate
classes.description: Handles navigation actions for WKWebView, particularly intercepting deep links with custom schemes.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: Handles message communication from JavaScript to Swift, processing UI actions.

methods.name: makeContainerView
methods.description: Creates and configures the container UIView and WKWebView, setting constraints and attaching it to the controller.

methods.name: updateController
methods.description: Updates the controller reference and ensures proper detachment and attachment of the web view.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up resources, removes handlers, and clears references.
